nodes.name: Anodic Electrodeposition of CoPi
nodes.procedure: CoPi films were grown by anodic electrodeposition from an electrolyte containing 0.1 M phosphate buffer (pH 7) and 0.5 mM Co(NO3)2 on ITO-glass electrodes or carbon thin film electrodes. Electrodeposition was performed at an applied potential of +1.34 V (vs NHE) for typically 60 minutes to achieve films with optical absorption of approximately 1 at 400 nm.

unit_operations.name: Electrochemical Deposition
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: electrodeposited at +1.34 V (vs NHE) with a net accumulation, typically 60 min

nodes.source_text: The CoPi films were grown from an electrolyte containing 0.1 M phosphate, pH 7 0.5 mM Co(NO3)2, on ITO-glass electrodes from an applied +1.34 V (vs NHE) with a net accumulation, typically 60 min... in situ electrochemical XANES spectra at the Co K-edge were measured on CoPi carbon thin film electrodes

nodes.description: OER LSV and Tafel analysis under 623 nm illumination in 0.1 M KPi pH 7
nodes.source_text: Figure 2a shows LSV sweeps measured in the dark and during continuous 623 nm illumination with 0.1 M phosphate, pH 7 electrolyte... 623 nm illumination show enhanced OER currents compared to traces recorded in the dark. Compared to the dark traces, 623 nm illumination is seen to produce an approximate 23 mV shift toward lower overpotential for OER catalysis.

nodes.description: OER LSV and Tafel analysis under 415 nm illumination in 0.1 M KPi pH 7 with Co(NO3)2
nodes.source_text: Figure 2b shows LSV sweeps for CoPi measured in the dark and during continuous 415 nm illumination with 0.1 M phosphate, pH 7 electrolyte... 415 nm illumination inhibits the OER currents... continuous illumination with 415 nm light is seen to produce an approximate 50 mV increase in the overpotential.

nodes.description: Thermal OER LSV and Tafel analysis in 0.1 M KPi pH 7 (20-60°C)
nodes.source_text: Panels c and f of Figure 2 show LSV and Tafel plots, respectively, for CoPi-supported electrodes in the dark and recorded with the KPi buffer electrolyte equilibrated at various temperatures between 20 and 60°C. Bulk thermal effects on LSV curves show a sharpening of the Co(III)/Co(II) redox transition peak at 1.0 V and an acceleration of the OER current with increasing temperature.

nodes.source_text: Figure 3a-c) Photocurrent measurements with 623 nm excitation at three set potentials +0.9 +1.1 and +1.3 V (vs NHE)... 623 nm illumination is seen to produce photoanodic currents.

nodes.description: Chopped light photocurrent transients at fixed potentials under 415 nm
nodes.source_text: Figure 3d-f) Photocurrent measurements with 415 nm excitation at three set potentials +0.9 +1.1, and +1.3 V... 415 nm illumination produces photocathodic current responses.

nodes.characterization_summary: Cyclic voltammogram shows anodic wave at 1.0 V vs NHE for Co(II)→Co(III) redox transition and second wave above 1.2 V for Co(III)→Co(IV) associated with catalysis onset.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1a shows a representative cyclic voltammogram (CV) for a CoPi film. An anodic wave is seen about 1.0 V (vs NHE) that is understood to arise from a Co(II)→Co(III) redox transition...

properties.description: Cyclic voltammetry or LSV graph showing cathodic and anodic current density vs overpotential

nodes.characterization_summary: Optical transmission spectra from 300-900 nm show broad absorption tail reduction at +0.9 V with d-d transition features; absorption increases with applied potential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Optical transmission spectra for in situ CoPi thin films held at applied potentials of +0.9, +1.1, and +1.3 V (vs NHE) are shown in Figure 1b, measured from 300 to 900 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Co K-edge XANES shows continuous edge shift to higher energies with increasing potential; at +0.91 V: 0.8% Co(II) Oh, 59.8% Co(II) Td+Co(III) Oh, 39.4% Co(III) Oh; pre-edge intensity grows with oxidation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ electrochemical Co K-edge XANES of CoPi with the inset displaying prominent changes in the pre-edge feature... A continuous edge shift toward higher energies with increasing set potential is observed.

properties.description: Normalized X-ray Absorption Near Edge Structure spectrum with pre-edge and edge regions

nodes.characterization_summary: Linear sweep voltammetry shows 623 nm illumination produces photoanodic currents enhancing OER currents above 1.2 V vs NHE; 415 nm illumination produces photocathodic responses inhibiting OER and accelerating film dissolution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2a shows LSV sweeps measured in the dark and during continuous 623 nm illumination... Figure 2b shows LSV sweeps for CoPi measured in the dark and during continuous 415 nm illumination...

nodes.characterization_summary: 623 nm illumination produces 23 mV shift toward lower overpotential for OER; 415 nm produces 50 mV increase in overpotential.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Compared to the dark traces, 623 nm illumination is seen to produce an approximate 23 mV shift toward lower overpotential for OER catalysis. In contrast, continuous illumination with 415 nm light is seen to produce an approximate 50 mV increase in the overpotential.
